description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.dom.element class, which represents and manipulates DOM elements within the CKEditor framework. It includes methods for creating, cloning, styling, attribute management, DOM traversal, and size calculations of DOM elements.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.element
classes.description: Class representing a DOM element with methods for creation, styling, attribute management, DOM traversal, and size manipulation within CKEditor.

methods.name: addClass
methods.description: Adds a CSS class to the element, appending it if not already present.

methods.name: removeClass
methods.description: Removes a CSS class from the element's class list.

methods.name: hasClass
methods.description: Checks if the element has a specific CSS class.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a child node or element to this element.

methods.name: appendHtml
methods.description: Appends HTML content as children of this element.

methods.name: appendText
methods.description: Appends text content to this element.

methods.name: appendBogus
methods.description: Appends a line break or text node if the last child is empty or not a break.

methods.name: breakParent
methods.description: Breaks an ancestor element, moving this element outside the broken parent.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if this element contains a specific node.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to this element, optionally deferred.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Returns the inner HTML of the element.

methods.name: getOuterHtml
methods.description: Returns the outer HTML of the element.

methods.name: setHtml
methods.description: Sets the inner HTML of the element.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the element.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute, with special handling for IE.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns a list of child nodes.

methods.name: getComputedStyle
methods.description: Gets the computed style value for a CSS property.

methods.name: getDtd
methods.description: Returns the DTD entries for this element.

methods.name: getElementsByTag
methods.description: Retrieves descendant elements by tag name.

methods.name: getTabIndex
methods.description: Returns the computed tab index of the element.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the element.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the window object containing this element.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the 'id' attribute value.

methods.name: getNameAtt
methods.description: Returns the 'name' attribute value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the tag name of the element in lowercase.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the element, typically for form fields.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the first child node, optionally filtered by evaluator.

methods.name: getLast
methods.description: Returns the last child node, optionally filtered by evaluator.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the inline style value for a CSS property.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if the element matches one or more tag names.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Determines if the element is editable based on DTD.

methods.name: isIdentical
methods.description: Checks if this element is identical to another, including attributes.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the element is visible.

methods.name: isEmptyInlineRemoveable
methods.description: Checks if the element is an empty inline element that can be removed without impact.

methods.name: hasAttributes
methods.description: Checks if the element has any attributes.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a specific attribute is present.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the element (display:none).

methods.name: moveChildren
methods.description: Moves all children to another element, optionally to the start.

methods.name: mergeSiblings
methods.description: Merges adjacent sibling elements if they are identical.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows the element (restores display and visibility).

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute value, with IE-specific handling.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets multiple attributes at once.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the element.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute, with IE-specific handling.

methods.name: removeAttributes
methods.description: Removes multiple attributes.

methods.name: removeStyle
methods.description: Removes a style property.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets a style property.

methods.name: setStyles
methods.description: Sets multiple style properties.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of the element.

methods.name: unselectable
methods.description: Makes the element and its children unselectable.

methods.name: getPositionedAncestor
methods.description: Returns the nearest ancestor with a non-static position.

methods.name: getDocumentPosition
methods.description: Calculates the element's position relative to the document.

methods.name: scrollIntoView
methods.description: Scrolls the element into view within its window.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the visual state of the element (on, off, disabled).

methods.name: getFrameDocument
methods.description: Returns the document inside an iframe element.

methods.name: copyAttributes
methods.description: Copies attributes from this element to another, optionally skipping some.

methods.name: renameNode
methods.description: Changes the tag name of the element, copying attributes and children.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves a descendant child node by index or path.

methods.name: getChildCount
methods.description: Returns the number of child nodes.

methods.name: disableContextMenu
methods.description: Disables the context menu on the element.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the text direction of the element.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Gets, sets, or removes custom data stored as data-* attributes.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the element with box model considerations.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Gets the size of the element, optionally content size.
